summary: This bill applies the "mailbox rule" to electronic submissions to the IRS, meaning the date a tax document or payment is electronically sent will be considered the date of delivery or payment, regardless of when the IRS receives it.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to apply the 'mailbox rule' to electronically submitted tax documents and payments. While it doesn't change tax rates or introduce new taxes, it affects the administrative process of tax payment and filing, potentially easing compliance for taxpayers by clarifying submission dates. This is a procedural change, not a substantive one regarding tax burden.
